//: Merge this into your project's opencode.json (or ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json). opencode has no plugin-manifest concept, so the wiring is explicit rather than installed. `apm install` performs the equivalent placement automatically; this file is the path for opencode users who are not using APM. Note the field names differ from .mcp.json on purpose: opencode takes `command` as an array and spells the environment block `environment`, where the Copilot/Claude schema takes `command` plus `args` and spells it `env`.
